Block: 839 Lots: 69 72 AMENDMENT OFZONINGLOT AND DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this “Amendment") is made as of the 24#  day of February, 2015, by and between 38-46 WEST 33 STREET LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at c/o The      REALTY, INC., a New York corporation having an address at 48 West 33rd Street, New York, New York 10001 ("Seller"). Recitals WHERAS, Developer is the owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 834, Lot 69 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYorkfor the Borough of Manhattan and known by the street address 38-46 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, and is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (*Developer's Land"); WHEREAS, Seller is the owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 834, Lot 72 on the Tax Map of the Cityof NewYorkfor theBorough of Manhattan and known by the street address 48 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, and is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto ("Seller's Land"); WHEREAS, Developer and Seller have executed that certain Zoning Lot and Development Agreement, dated as of January 6, 2011, which Zoning and Lot Development Agreement was recorded on January 19, 2011 in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York as CRFN 2011000023228 (the “ZLDA"); WHEREAS, Developer and Seller wish to amend the ZLDA to adjust the amount of Retained Development Rights, the amount of Excess Development Rights, and the elevation of the Light and Air Easement; to provide for certain construction easements; and to provide for easements that allow aportionof Developer'sProposedBuilding toencroachupon and remain located over and above aportionof theSeller's Land; WHEREAS, Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company has certified in a certificate annexed hereto as Exhibit C that as of December 8, 2014, Developer, Seller, Manufacturers Traders and Trust Company, Columbia Capital Co., and Empire 33 Parking LLC are the only parties-in-interest (as that term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork) in the Developer's Land and theSeller's Land; and WHEREAS, Manufacturers Traders and Trust Company, Columbia Capital Co., and Empire 33 Parking LLC have executed instruments consenting to this Amendment, copies of whichinstruments are annexed hereto asExhibitD; NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the sufficiency and receipt of and their successors-in-interest and assigns as follows: 1.  All capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in theZLDA. 2. Recital F of the ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following: As used herein “Excess Development Rights” shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by those improvements located on Seller's Land as of January 6, 2011, but expressly excludes Four Thousand Sixty Four shall be retained by Seller. For purposes of clarification, the term Excess Development Rights and the calculation thereof excludes the Retained Development Rights. The parties hereto agree that the Excess Development Rights constitute Twenty Thousand Two Hundred Seventy (20,270) square feet of floorarea. 3. Section 1.2 of the ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety and replace with the following: Section 1.2 Seller hereby grants, transfers and conveys to Developer, its successors and assigns an exclusive perpetual easement for light and air over and above Seller's Existing Building above a horizontal plane at an elevation of established by the National Geodetic Survey (NGS) (said elevation also being 104.70 feet above the Datum established for the BoroughPresident of Manhattan (MBPO) Datum) as shown on the survey annexed hereto as Exhibit E-2 and referred to therein as “Restrictive Easement 1",and Seller covenants that no building, structure or improvements will be constructed or allowed at a height above the aforesaid horizontal plane, except that, in the portion of Seller's Property described as the “Permitted Mechanical Area" and shown on the survey annexed hereto as Exhibit E-2, below a horizontal plane at an elevation of 116.35 feet above the North AmericanVertical Datum of 1988 (NAVD88)established by the National Geodetic Survey, Seller or its designees may add, replace and maintain mechanical equipment, water tanks, antennas, satellite dishes, and other fixtures, equipment, devices and structures including without limitation stairs and elevator bulkheads necessary for the use or operation of the Existing Building and any future building on Seller's Property (the “Mechanical Equipment'") but in no event shall the Mechanical Equipment be located above the aforesaid horizontal plane and/or in any area other than the Permitted Mechanical Area, as aforesaid. 4. Exhibit A to the ZLDA is replaced with Schedule A hereto. 2 F:VASMTORKIAN48WEST33RDSTREETZLDA.DOC
